name: Queensland Looking after Country Grant Program

funder.name: Queensland Government (Department of the Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation)

summary: Grants of up to A$75,000 for First Nations organisations in Queensland to plan and deliver on-ground conservation work on Country, such as revegetation, habitat restoration, fire management and species monitoring.

eligibility.rule: Not receive ranger employment funding unless applying for an unengaged Traditional Owner group
Have no overdue DETSI grant acquittals or reports

status.quote: The successful applicants for the 2025 Looking After Country Grant Program have been announced.

applicant_types.quote: First Nations organisations are funded to engage communities in planning for and delivering on-ground conservation work on Country.

geography.quote: Seven First Nations organisations from across Queensland, including Innisfail, Chillagoe and Toowoomba have been awarded funding

access.quote: The successful applicants for the 2025 Looking After Country Grant Program have been announced.

amount.quote: provides funding of up to $75,000 to First Nations communities to care for the environmental and cultural values of Country.

effort.quote: Make sure you have provided all the requested information and submit your stage 1 application before the closing date of Wednesday 9 July 2025.
Step 3 - Assessment by panel and short-listing

eligibility.quote: Organisations that receive funding for the employment of Indigenous rangers under the Queensland Indigenous Land and Sea Ranger Program, or the Indigenous Ranger Program funded through the National Indigenous Australians Agency, unless they can demonstrate that the application is made on behalf of Traditional Owner groups that are not engaged in the organisation’s existing ranger program.
Organisations that currently have overdue acquittals or reports in relation to any grant funding provided by the Department of the Environment Science and Innovation (DETSI).

after_award.quote: Successful recipients will be required to submit periodic project reports based on the completion of project milestones, and a final report and acquittal documentation, using a template provided by DETSI.
